# Model team

This page describes the agent harness of this project for people. Agents do not need to read it.

| Role | File or setting | Model | Effort |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| orchestrator | `model` in `.claude/settings.json` | opus | xhigh |
| advisor | `advisorModel` in `.claude/settings.json` | fable | - |
| advisor fallback | `.claude/agents/fallback-advisor.md` | opus | xhigh |
| reviewer | `.claude/agents/checker.md` | opus | high |
| researcher | `.claude/agents/Explore.md` | haiku | high |
| implementer | `.claude/agents/implementer.md` | sonnet | high |
| spec-writer | `.claude/agents/spec-writer.md` | sonnet | high |
| helper | `env.CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` | haiku | - |

## Advisor

At each consult, the advisor reads the whole context. The price of the advisor model applies. If the advisor tool is missing, fails or declines, the main model briefs `fallback-advisor`.

## Subagent model

A subagent that has no model of its own uses the helper model. An Agent tool call with a `model` parameter overrides it.

## Outage

`fallbackModel` replaces the main model only when it is overloaded or not available.

## No access to the advisor model

Run `/model fable` once and approve the usage billing. Then select the main model again. Until then, `fallback-advisor` gives the advice.

## Precedence

This project file has priority over the user settings. The options `--model`, `--effort` and `--advisor`, and a resumed session, have priority over this project file.

## Reload

Claude Code reloads `advisorModel`, `fallbackModel`, `env` and the `.claude/agents` directory while it runs. Claude Code reads `model` and `modelSettings` only when a session starts.

## Hooks

`context-meter` tells an agent the size of its context once at each level. `fanout-cap` asks the person before a workflow whose agent count can exceed the cap. Each teammate needs spec-dna 0.5.0 or later on `PATH`. Without it, the hooks do nothing.

## Check after a restart

1. Read the header. It shows the main model.
2. Run `/advisor`. It shows the advisor.
3. Type `@`. The list shows the agents.
4. Run `/tasks`. It lists the running agents.
5. When Claude consults the advisor, an `Advising` line shows. Press `Ctrl+O` to read the advice.
6. Run `/usage`. It shows the cost of each model.

Generated by spec-dna. Change `[harness]` in `spec-dna.toml` and run `spec-dna init --reconfigure`.
